description: SAML decoder + security audit — Decode and audit a SAML 2.0 message offline. saml= takes a SAMLResponse or SAMLRequest exactly as captured (HTTP-POST base64, HTTP-Redirect base64 + raw DEFLATE, URL-encoded or not) or raw XML, including IdP/SP metadata (EntityDescriptor). Returns type, binding, issuer, destination, status, NameID, subject confirmation, conditions/audience, authn context, attributes, signature algorithms and certificate SHA-256/SHA-1 fingerprints, plus issues: unsigned assertions, signature-wrapping patterns (reference not pointing at the signed ID, multiple or nested assertions), comments inside NameID (CVE-2017-11427 class), DOCTYPE/XXE, SHA-1 signatures, expired or missing conditions, missing audience/recipient, plain-HTTP endpoints, expired metadata. Verdict OK / REVIEW / REJECT. Structural checks only: signatures are not cryptographically verified. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_saml_decode
